notes.notes: I broke Platformer 9.5 with the last update. It is fixed now!

notes.title: Bugfixes and small updates.
notes.notes:
Some bugfixes and small updates.

Skins now remembers which skin you have selected.
Music no longer turns itself back on after Credits if player doesn't want it.
"Fueled by Fusion" is now in the credits.
Club unlocks upon beating the game instead of beating the expansion.
Streamer shoutouts to Les and IRL_Dex.
Beating All 11.11 no longer resets your progress if you've beaten expansion levels.

notes.title: spec.io coming soon
notes.notes: There are still some things I don't like but I'm getting closer!

notes.title: QoL Updates
notes.notes:
Many small updates:

HUD for Volleyball
HUD for Maze
Recharge timer for Platformer
Took out some randomness for Volleyball
Fixed the blue outline in later Dodge levels
Coyote time for Platformer
Start a little closer in Volleyball

notes.title: Windowed Mode
notes.notes: Now you can switch between Full Screen and Windowed Mode in the settings.

notes.title: Maze Movement Easing
notes.notes: No more getting stuck by a pixel.

notes.title: Free Expansion Update: Nov 2024
notes.notes:
Enjoy the additional levels!

(I tested it best I could, but I am only one Euch. If you find problems or bugs, let me know and I'll get them sorted)

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Some minor changes:

-Boss has a health bar now
-A reminder text when the "beckon" ability first shows up
-Can toggle the Music on and off in Settings

notes.title: Online Volleyball bug squashed
notes.notes: After playing volleyball online and returning to the main screen you could get a Lacewing error message. No longer.

notes.title: Counting Bug Fixed
notes.notes: Corrected a bug where you could discover the correct answer within the counting levels.
